name: Quill Purnell
source:
An offbeat and endearing catgirl, whose serene demeanor belies her peculiar habits and eccentricities. Dotty and utterly unselfconscious, she lives fearless the way she truly feels - as a kitty girl who could use a nice belly rub.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sadpandastudios/hush-hush-only-your-love-can-save-them/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
